title: What 5G Actually Changes

segments.say: Is 5G just faster internet on your phone? Speed is only one of three things it was designed to change.
The global telecom body, the ITU, named three uses: much faster mobile broadband, ultra-reliable links with almost no delay, and huge numbers of connected machines.
Its targets include peak downloads of twenty gigabits a second, and delays of just one millisecond for critical links, fast enough for remote control of machines.
And it aims to connect a million devices in a single square kilometre.
That density is what lets factories, farms and cities link sensors and machines, not just people. This is the Internet of Things.

items.text: test bed with IITs, IISc and SAMEER

segments.say: India built a 5G test bed with the IITs from twenty eighteen, auctioned spectrum in twenty twenty-two, and launched services on the first of October that year.
For GS Three, link 5G to three words: spectrum, latency, and the Internet of Things.

sources: ITU-R Report M.2410-0, minimum requirements for IMT-2020: downlink peak data rate 20 Gbit/s; user-plane latency 4 ms for eMBB and 1 ms for URLLC; connection density 1,000,000 devices per km²
ITU-R Recommendation M.2083: three usage scenarios, eMBB, URLLC and mMTC

PIB (PRID 1863659): 5G launched on 1 October 2022 at India Mobile Congress, Pragati Maidan; 51,236 MHz allocated; DoT 5G test bed with IITs, IISc and SAMEER from 2018; IoT, M2M and edge-computing use cases

quiz.q: Which is NOT one of ITU's three 5G usage scenarios?
quiz.why: The three are eMBB, URLLC and mMTC.

quiz.q: What latency target does ITU set for ultra-reliable 5G links?
quiz.why: 1 ms user-plane latency for URLLC (4 ms for broadband).

quiz.q: When were 5G services launched in India?
quiz.why: PIB: launched on 1 October 2022 at India Mobile Congress.

reviewNote: Targets come from ITU-R M.2410-0 and M.2083, India facts from PIB. These are design targets, not speeds users see; the script says 'targets'. The 2022 auction year is inferred from the PIB launch release, which gives the spectrum allotted; check. Avoid any brand name on the tower photos. The million-devices ring is decorative (full ring). Moving facts: India's 5G coverage and user numbers (none given).
